title: Data Migration Analyst
description:
Data Migration Business Analyst – Investment Management

Interim Contract – Outside IR35

£450–£550 per day

Central London – Remote/Hybrid Working

Initial 3–6 Month Contract


We're supporting a growing investment and wealth management business looking to appoint an experienced Data Migration Business Analyst on an interim basis. The business employs around 40 people, managing private wealth, collective investment schemes and direct private equity investments.


This is a hands-on role supporting the implementation of a new investment management platform (FA Solutions), migrating client and investment data from existing systems, spreadsheets and manual processes.


We're looking for someone who combines investment management knowledge with proven data migration experience, and understands how investment data impacts portfolio management, reporting and downstream operations.


The Role

Working closely with the Investment Operations team and wider project stakeholders, you'll take responsibility for analysing, cleansing, mapping, migrating and reconciling investment data into the new platform.

You'll need a strong understanding of the investment lifecycle, including holdings, transactions, pricing, custodians and performance data, ensuring information is accurately migrated and functions correctly within the new system.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the mapping, cleansing and migration of client and investment data from existing systems into FA Solutions
  • Analyse and reconcile complex datasets, including holdings, transactions, fees, restrictions, client models and performance history
  • Work with Investment Operations and custodians to ensure accurate pricing, corporate actions and investment transaction data
  • Identify discrepancies, resolve data issues and validate the accuracy of migrated information
  • Support the development of new data management and reconciliation processes
  • Understand and validate the downstream impact of investment data on reporting, portfolio management and operational processes
  • Coordinate UAT, testing and data validation, working with stakeholders to achieve sign-off
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external platform providers to support successful implementation


What We're Looking For

  • Proven data migration or business analysis experience within investment or wealth management – essential
  • Strong understanding of investment operations, collective investment schemes, private equity and alternative investments
  • Experience with portfolio data, holdings, transactions, fee structures, restrictions and performance history
  • Previous involvement in investment platform implementations or transformation projects
  • Strong Excel and data reconciliation skills, comfortable working with complex financial datasets
  • Experience supporting UAT, testing and data validation
  • Understanding of custodians, outsourced investment platforms and regulated financial environments
  • Proactive, analytical and comfortable working independently within a smaller team
  • Experience with FA Solutions or Expersoft advantageous but not essential


Why Join?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a key workstream within a significant investment management platform implementation, working closely with senior stakeholders in a growing business.

The company offers flexible hybrid working, although greater office presence will be expected during the initial weeks.


Apply Now

If you're an experienced Data Migration Analyst, Investment Management Business Analyst or Investment Operations Consultant with a strong understanding of investment data and systems implementations, we'd love to hear from you.
